**1) Header logo:** Yes — the gold star + "BENGAL STAR LIMITED COMPANY" is fully visible, well-sized, not distorted, no black box behind it.

**2) Navbar:** Yes — clean layout; hamburger button fully visible, Arabic pill and logo fit, no horizontal cutoff.

**3) Footer logo chip:** Yes — the stacked star + text logo sits cleanly inside the white rounded chip, undistorted, no clipping.

**4) Layout issues:** Two minor ones:
- Image 2: floating WhatsApp and scroll-to-top buttons overlap the Quick Links ("Why Us" is partially covered).
- Image 1: the floating WhatsApp button slightly overlaps the "Client satisfaction" stat text ("satisfac..." clipped behind it).

Otherwise no overflow, clipping, or distortion.
